newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ARSENAL GO TOP DESPITE BEING HELD TO GOALLESS DRAW.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ARSENAL GO TOP DESPITE BEING HELD TO GOALLESS DRAW.

text.p: Arsenal went top of the English premier league for the first time in four years on Saturday, despite being held to a goalless draw at home by second-to-bottom Coventry.
The Gunners moved on to 21 points -- the same as Wimbledon who moved up to second after chalking up their seventh successive league victory with a 4-2 win at Chelsea.
Wimbledon won with goals from Robbie Earle, Neil Ardley, Marcus Gayle and Efan Ekoku while Chelsea replied through Scott Minto and a late penalty from Gianluca Vialli.
Arsenal's stay in first place may be a short one.
Previous leaders Newcastle slipped to third but are also on 21 points and will go back on top if they beat Manchester United on Sunday.
A minute's silence was held before the start of all matches as a mark of respect to the 84 victims of this week's Guatamalan stadium disaster.
